clips.caption:
Ancient societies didn't put kings at the top. Kevin lays out the old caste system plainly: peasants, then merchants, then the warrior class - the kings, the governments, the ones who protected the community.

But above even the warriors sat another class. The priests. The philosophers. The ones who could read when almost no one else could, who held knowledge and religion in the same hands.

For most of history, intellect and the sacred were never separate. Today we've split them - and lost something in the split.
